name: Machine Learning Summer School (MLSS) 2027 Okinawa
funder: Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology (OIST)
amount: No travel grant. Accommodation is provided in kind to a limited number of accepted participants (OIST housing or a shared hotel room). Registration fee for academics is about JPY 120,000.
eligibility: Mainly Master's/PhD students; small number of researchers, professors and practitioners also considered
eligibility_note: No nationality restriction stated; visa invitation letters provided. Postdoc admission not explicitly mentioned (falls under 'researchers').
how_to_apply_tip: Check the Application page immediately - the window may be closing; request a visa invitation letter from mlss2027@oist.jp right after acceptance.
deadline_quote: Poster abstract deadline (official application deadline): September 30, 2026 ... CV & references / OpenReview site closes: October 10, 2026
verdict_reason: The school is open to all applicants, and faculty can be admitted to a limited number of places. There are no nationality, age or institution limits. However, the 2027 application window closed on 2026-09-30, with OpenReview closing on 2026-10-10. No travel money is offered, only in-kind housing, and academics pay a fee of about JPY 120,000.
eligibility_quote: MLSS Okinawa 2027 is open to all applicants. ... Our main target audience is master's and Ph.D. students ... A small number of industry practitioners, professors, researchers ... may also be considered. | Accommodation support does not cover travel expenses.

name: HEC Post-Doctoral Fellowship Program (Phase III)
amount: Living allowance (reported ~USD 1,600/month, varies by host country) + one-time health insurance, airfare and research/bench costs – see Financial Support page
eligibility: Age <= 45; local HEC-attested PhD, or foreign PhD + 5 years work in Pakistan; regular employee of HEC-recognized HEI or PCST-recognized R&D org; no previous postdoc (>3 months); placement at QS top-200 university
eligibility_note: Only for Pakistani regular employees of Pakistani HEIs/R&D orgs; foreign-PhD holders need 5 years post-PhD service in Pakistan (local-PhD holders do not)
how_to_apply_tip: Secure a placement letter from a QS top-200 supervisor (dated within 6 months) and a 9-month leave NOC before the portal (pdfp.hec.gov.pk) opens.
deadline_quote: Portal "will be opened for a specific duration according to Pakistan Standard Time (PST) and the last date will not be extended in any case." The official programme page gives no current batch dates.
verdict_reason: Applicants must be regular employees of an HEC-recognised university or degree-awarding institution, and BIC is a private TNE college, not a DAI. A foreign PhD also needs 5 years of recognised work in Pakistan after the PhD. The last batch date (2025-10-30) appears only in secondary sources, not on HEC's pages.
eligibility_quote: Be a regular employee of public/private sector HEC recognized university/degree awarding institution or public sector R&D organization (recognized by Pakistan Council of Science & Technology). | Possess five years' recognized work experience in Pakistan after completion of foreign Ph.D. | Not be more than 45 years of age on the date mentioned in the advertisement.

name: Talented Young Scientist Program (TYSP)
funder: Ministry of Science and Technology of China / China Science and Technology Exchange Center
eligibility: Under 45, doctoral degree and >5 years research experience; hosted by a Chinese university, institute or company
eligibility_note: Programme targets young scientists from developing (Afro-Asian / Belt and Road) countries; Pakistani researchers have been selected (e.g. IUB lecturer, 2026), but exclusion list on official page is garbled – confirm
how_to_apply_tip: The Chinese host institution registers on the TYSP platform and submits your information – find a host by December for the Jan-Mar call.
deadline_quote: 2026 TYSP call notice (dated 2026-01-16) sets the application deadline as 16 March 2026 (system notification time governs).
verdict_reason: The official guide requires the applicant to be under 45, to hold a doctorate and to have at least 5 years of research experience. It is unclear whether pre-PhD research counts toward the 5 years, since the profile's PhD is under 2 years old. The age limit is also borderline for a 45-year-old. The country list on the official page is garbled and could not be read.
eligibility_quote: (Implementation guide, translated) Under 45 years old ... at least 5 years of research experience and a doctoral degree (具有博士学位) ... currently working abroad full-time. Funding 20,000 RMB per month pre-tax for 3, 6 or 12 months.
ask_funder: Does the 'at least 5 years of research experience' rule count research done before the doctorate (my PhD was awarded in 2025)? Is Pakistan an eligible country, and is the age limit 'under 45' applied at the application date?

name: Sindh HEC International Post-Doctoral Fellowship Programme (Phase II)
amount: Living allowance up to USD 1,500/month (PPP-based) + USD 2,000 health insurance + USD 6,000 research/bench fee + PKR 350,000 return airfare
eligibility: HEC-recognized PhD; regular employee of a Sindh public/private HEI; age <= 50; preferably 5 years post-PhD experience in Sindh; placement at QS top-200 (top-500 considered); Digital Innovation is a priority area
eligibility_note: Requires Sindh domicile and PRC (Form C) plus employment at a Sindh HEI
how_to_apply_tip: Arrange the host placement letter first; post the hard copy and email the PDF to ad.qa@sindhhec.gov.pk with all NOCs.
deadline_quote: LAST DATE OF APPLICATION SUBMISSION: 31ST MARCH 2026
verdict_reason: The scheme is limited to regular faculty of universities/DAIs or HEIs in Sindh who hold Sindh domicile and a PRC. BIC is not a university or DAI, and Sindh domicile is not in the profile. The scheme also prefers 5 years of experience in Sindh after the PhD.
eligibility_quote: Applications are invited from the regular faculty members of Public and Private sector universities/DAIs and professionals of regulatory bodies of HE in Sindh ... Be a regular employee of public/private sector universities/HEIs in Sindh. ... Hold Domicile & Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC- Form C) of the Sindh Province.

name: PERIDOT – Pakistan-France Hubert Curien Partnership (researcher mobility)
funder: HEC Pakistan & Campus France / French Ministries
amount: HEC covers Pakistani researchers: PKR 280,000 per round trip, plus EUR 125 per day for stays of 10 days or less, or EUR 65 per day for longer stays up to 1.5 months. Funds are released yearly for up to 3 years.
eligibility: PI must be regular faculty (PhD) at a Pakistani public/private HEI (or contract covering project duration) with a French partner who applies in parallel; PhD students integrated
eligibility_note: Bilateral HEC-France programme exclusively for Pakistani university researchers paired with French teams
how_to_apply_tip: Find a French collaborator early – both sides must submit (Campus France + HEC) or the proposal is rejected; recent priority themes are health, energy, agriculture, climate economics, so frame AI as an enabler.
deadline_quote: The deadline to apply is September 30, 2026.
verdict_reason: The PI must be regular PhD faculty at a public or private Higher Education Institution. It is unclear whether HEC treats a private TNE college delivering UK degrees, which is not HEC-chartered, as an 'HEI'. The Phase XIII call closed on 2026-09-30.
eligibility_quote: Applicant (PI) must be a regular faculty member (PhD or FCPS/MCPS/FRCS) of the Higher Education Institutions (public and private) or hold a contract equivalent to the length of project duration. | A joint application ... submitted to Campus France is a mandatory pre-requisite for applying to this grant.
ask_funder: Can a regular PhD faculty member at a private transnational college in Pakistan that delivers UK university degrees (not HEC-chartered or degree-awarding) act as Pakistani PI for PERIDOT?

name: Fulbright Scholar Program (Pakistan) – postdoctoral research / lectureship in the US
amount: Airfare, living stipend, health insurance, research allowance + support for one dependent
eligibility: PhD/terminal degree, all fields except clinical medicine; invitation letter from US university; NOT eligible if PhD earned within last 2 years or in US for research/study in last 5 years
eligibility_note: Pakistani citizens living/working in Pakistan; dual US nationals excluded. Profile note: becomes eligible once PhD is >2 years old
how_to_apply_tip: Start emailing US hosts in summer 2027: an invitation letter must be in the application, along with 3 references.
verdict_reason: The profile's PhD was awarded within the last 2 years, which the page explicitly excludes. The applicant could become eligible in a cycle that starts after the PhD is more than 2 years old.
eligibility_quote: Applicants who completed their Ph.D. within the last two years ... are not eligible.

name: TÜBİTAK 2221 Fellowships for Visiting Scientists and Scientists on Sabbatical Leave
amount: Up to TRY 81,000 per month (visiting scientist) or TRY 105,000 per month (sabbatical), plus health insurance support of up to TRY 560 per month for 3–12 month stays. Round-trip airfare is included.
eligibility: PhD holders working at universities/research institutions abroad; host scientist (full-time, PhD) at a Turkish university or TÜBİTAK centre applies
eligibility_note: TÜBİTAK page states no nationality restriction; aimed at Turkish and other scientists working abroad.
how_to_apply_tip: Four calls a year (next window 2-30 Nov 2026). Register on ARBİS with your passport name; the Turkish host writes the proposal (in Turkish) and submits it.
deadline_quote: 4th term: opens 02 Nov 2026, closes 30 Nov 2026. The system will be closed to applications at 17:30 on the application deadline.
verdict_reason: No nationality restriction is stated, and the Turkish host applies. However, PhD holders in doctoral-level posts abroad must have worked at a university, research centre or company for at least 4 years. The page does not say whether those years must come after the PhD, and the profile's PhD is under 2 years old.
eligibility_quote: Scientists who hold a doctorate and work abroad in a position requiring one must have been working in a university, research center, or private sector for at least 4 years as of the application date. | The host scientist must be a full-time staff member of the host institution in Türkiye and hold at least a doctoral degree.
ask_funder: Does the 4-year work-experience rule for visiting scientists count academic employment before the PhD (for example, as a lecturer), or only years after the doctorate? Does employment at a private TNE college in Pakistan count as a 'university'?

name: Ernst Mach Grant – Worldwide
funder: OeAD (Austria's Agency for Education and Internationalisation)
amount: Monthly grant (see website) + help with insurance and accommodation; supplementary own funds needed
eligibility: Young researchers (PhD students and postdocs) of all disciplines, aged 35 or under; Austrian host
eligibility_note: OeAD: 'young researchers from all disciplines and countries (except Austria)'.
how_to_apply_tip: Postdocs must show employment at their home university; get a supervision letter from an Austrian host (e.g., TU Wien, JKU Linz) before 1 Dec.
deadline_quote: Ernst Mach Grant - worldwide ... Application deadline: December 1st (online applications from September)
verdict_reason: The age limit is 35, and the profile is 36–45. The Ernst Mach Follow-Up Grant (age 45 or under) requires a previous funded visit to Austria, so it does not apply either.
eligibility_quote: young researchers from all disciplines and countries (except Austria); age limit 35 years

name: ICTP Junior Associates
funder: Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP)
amount: 3 round-trip travel fares over 6 years + ICTP hospitality during visits
duration: 6-year appointment; 3 visits of 30-60 days (max 180 days total)
eligibility: PhD holders aged 35 or under with main affiliation at an institute in a developing country; fields include Scientific Computing, AI and Data Science (ICOMP)
eligibility_note: ICTP: open to scientists whose main affiliation is in a developing country (Pakistan is a developing country per ICTP/UN lists).
how_to_apply_tip: Needs two recommendation letters from senior scientists (preferably outside your institute); name the ICOMP/Scientific Computing, AI & Data Science section as your target.
verdict_reason: The category is limited to applicants aged 35 or under, and the profile is 36–45. Regular Associates (item 70) is the matching category.
eligibility_quote: up to the age of 35 at the time of application ... All applicants must hold a PhD and have their main affiliation in a scientific institute in a developing country.

name: ICTP Regular Associates
funder: Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP)
amount: 3 round-trip travel fares over 6 years + ICTP hospitality during visits
duration: 6-year appointment; 3 visits of 30-60 days (max 180 days total)
eligibility: PhD holders aged 36-45 affiliated with an institute in a developing country; includes Scientific Computing, AI and Data Science
eligibility_note: ICTP: main affiliation with a scientific institute in a developing country.
how_to_apply_tip: Use this instead of Junior Associates if you are 36+; plan visits of at least 30 days to qualify for the travel fare.
verdict_reason: Age 36–45, a PhD and Pakistan (on ICTP's supported-country list) all fit, and the Scientific Computing, AI and Data Science (ICOMP) field is explicitly welcomed. Two questions remain: whether a private TNE teaching college counts as a 'scientific institute', and whether the age limit of 45 is checked at award (2027) if the applicant is near 45.
eligibility_quote: Regular Associates are scientists aged between 36 and 45 who hold a PhD and are working in developing countries. ... we are also welcoming applications in the new field of Scientific Computing, AI and Data Science (ICOMP). ... All applicants must hold a PhD and have their main affiliation in a scientific institute in a developing country.
ask_funder: Is a private transnational higher-education college in Pakistan (delivering UK university degrees, with active research output) accepted as the 'main affiliation in a scientific institute in a developing country'? Is the 36–45 age range checked at application or at award?

name: TWAS-FAPESP Postdoctoral Fellowship Programme for Developing Countries
amount: FAPESP postdoctoral (PD) fellowship monthly rate (FAPESP Scholarship Values Table) plus an Installation Grant. Up to 20 fellowships.
eligibility: PhD within the last 7 years in natural, applied or social sciences (incl. engineering and mathematical sciences); no age limit; host in São Paulo State
eligibility_note: TWAS: open to nationals of 'all developing countries' (TWAS list includes Pakistan).
how_to_apply_tip: Supervisors register expressions of interest by 1 Nov 2026 and the list is published 1 Dec 2026; pick a CS/engineering supervisor from that list, who submits the full proposal by 1 Apr 2027.
deadline_quote: Deadline for submission of proposals: 01/04/2027 (expression-of-interest deadline for supervisors 01/11/2026; list of potential supervisors announced 01/12/2026)
verdict_reason: Pakistan is on the TWAS developing-countries list, the PhD is within 7 years, there is no age limit and engineering is covered. The candidate must not hold a Brazilian or developed-country residence visa. This is a 12-month, full-stipend postdoc that requires leave, which is a format the profile does not want.
eligibility_quote: a) Be a permanent resident and natural-born of one of the developing countries, listed in https://twas.org/subset/all-developing-countries; b) Not have a temporary or permanent residence visa in Brazil or in any developed country; ... d) Hold a doctorate in a natural, applied or social sciences area; e) Apply for the Scholarship within seven (07) years after obtaining the doctorate

name: MSCA Staff Exchanges 2027 (HORIZON-MSCA-2027-SE-01-01)
amount: EUR unit costs per person-month of secondment (see call)
eligibility: Staff of consortium partner organisations (any career stage) actively engaged in the project
eligibility_note: Pakistan is on the Horizon Europe list of low/middle-income countries automatically eligible for funding, so Pakistani partner staff secondments can be funded.
how_to_apply_tip: You cannot apply alone: join an EU-led consortium as a Pakistani partner. Contact EU AI groups now, since the 2027 call is expected to open 15 Dec 2026.
deadline_quote: EU Funding & Tenders Portal topic HORIZON-MSCA-2027-SE-01-01: status Forthcoming; planned opening 2026-12-15; deadline 2027-04-15 (single stage). Previous call HORIZON-MSCA-2026-SE-01-01 closed 2026-04-16.
verdict_reason: Staff of any nationality and career stage can be seconded, and Pakistan is on the official list of low- and middle-income countries eligible for funding. The applicant must join a consortium with at least two organisations from EU or Associated Countries, and BIC must be a legal entity.
eligibility_quote: Staff can be researchers at any career stage ... can be of any nationality. | To be eligible for funding, applicants must be established in one of the following countries: ... the following low- and middle-income countries: ... Pakistan, Palau, Palestine ...

name: JSPS Invitational Fellowships for Research in Japan (Short-term)
funder: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS)
amount: JPY 18,000 per day + round-trip economy airfare + travel insurance + up to JPY 150,000 research support (host)
eligibility: Full-time researcher at a foreign university/institute at a position equivalent to assistant professor or above, OR 6+ years since PhD; host researcher in Japan applies
eligibility_note: JSPS: candidates must be citizens or permanent residents of a country with diplomatic relations with Japan (Pakistan qualifies).
how_to_apply_tip: The Japanese host submits (forms S-1 to S-3); host institutions set internal deadlines up to a month earlier than JSPS's 23 Apr 2027 round (arrival Oct 2027–Mar 2028). Being an assistant professor in Pakistan meets the career rule.
deadline_quote: 2nd recruitment (Short-term only): Application deadline (from host institution to JSPS) April 23, 2027 (by 5 p.m. (JST)); arrival October 1, 2027 - March 31, 2028. Host institutions may set deadlines more than one month earlier.
verdict_reason: Pakistan has diplomatic relations with Japan, and Associate Professor is an equivalent position. However, the rule requires a post at 'a university or research institution in a foreign country', and BIC is a private TNE college. The 6-years-since-PhD alternative route does not apply because the PhD is under 2 years old.
eligibility_quote: (1) Be a citizen or permanent resident of a country that has diplomatic relations with Japan. (2) Be a full-time researchers or person with full-time researcher status at a university or research institution in a foreign country and have a position equivalent to a professor, associate professor or assistant professor in Japan ... Researchers of other status may apply if it has been six years or longer since they obtained their doctoral degree
ask_funder: Does JSPS accept a full-time Associate Professor at a private transnational higher-education college in Pakistan (delivering University of Essex and LJMU degrees) as holding a position 'at a university or research institution in a foreign country'?

name: ERCIM Alain Bensoussan Fellowship Programme
funder: European Research Consortium for Informatics and Mathematics (ERCIM)
amount: 12-month fellowship. Net monthly allowance is about EUR 1,807–4,415 depending on host (e.g. CNR EUR 2,240; CWI EUR 2,625; Fraunhofer EUR 3,000; NTNU EUR 4,415). Travel is covered up to EUR 500 per trip (2 trips), plus EUR 100 per month each for research exchange and conferences.
eligibility: Recent PhD holders in computer science, informatics, applied mathematics
eligibility_note: ERCIM: fellowships 'for PhD holders from all over the world'.
how_to_apply_tip: Register on the site for round alerts and contact a researcher at an ERCIM member institute (e.g., Inria, CWI, SINTEF) before applying.
verdict_reason: The fellowship is open to PhD holders worldwide who received the PhD in the last 8 years, with no age or institution limits. The host cannot share the applicant's nationality. This is a 12-month, full-stipend postdoc, a format the profile does not want.
eligibility_quote: The Fellowships are available for PhD holders from all over the world. ... have obtained a PhD degree during the last 8 years ... a member institute will not be eligible to host a candidate of the same nationality.

name: Training and Research in Italian Laboratories (TRIL)
amount: EUR 1,500 per month (PhD under 5 years old) or EUR 1,600 per month (PhD over 5 years old), plus a prepaid ticket and health insurance if needed. The host lab is expected to co-fund.
duration: A few months, up to a maximum of 24 months including extensions
eligibility: Nationals of and residents in a developing country with at least a Master's; physics-related fields incl. computational physics, wireless ICT/IoT, digital fabrication
eligibility_note: ICTP: applicants must be nationals of a developing country and live in one when selected; developed-country individuals are not eligible.
how_to_apply_tip: Find an Italian lab among ICTP's 400+ partner institutes first and get them to agree to co-fund; frame AI work within computational physics or ICT/IoT.
verdict_reason: The applicant is a Pakistani national living in Pakistan (on ICTP's supported-country list) and holds more than a Master's. No age, gender or institution limits are stated. The research must fit TRIL's physics-related fields, such as Wireless ICT/IoT or Science, Technology and Innovation.
eligibility_quote: be a national of a developing country; ... be in possession of at least a university Master's Degree; reside in a developing country (studying or working) at the time of selection. ... Individuals from developed countries are not eligible to apply to the TRIL Programme.
